description: ICT Risk Management and Execution Discipline rules enforcing capital preservation, position sizing, invalidation logic, and strict 1:2.0 minimum Risk-to-Reward ratio.

topics.name: Risk Percentage Capital Allocation
rules: Never risk more than 1.0% to 2.0% of total account capital on a single setup.
Preserve capital above all; losing streaks must never exceed manageable drawdowns.

topics.name: Risk-to-Reward Ratio (1:2.0 Minimum)

deterministic_criteria.hard_gate: If RR < 2.0, setup is strictly REJECTED (action = WAIT)

rules: Every institutional execution must offer at least 1:2.0 Risk-to-Reward ratio to TP1.
Setups offering 1:1 or less are statistically negative expectancy over large sample sizes.

topics.name: Deterministic Lot Sizing for Gold (XAU/USD)
rules: Lot size is dynamically derived from dollar risk capital and exact distance to the invalidation stop loss.
Never use arbitrary fixed lot sizes; size is mathematically calibrated for every trade.

topics.name: Stop Loss Placement & Structural Invalidation

deterministic_criteria.bullish_sl: Placed 1-2 points below the extreme of the swept swing low
deterministic_criteria.bearish_sl: Placed 1-2 points above the extreme of the swept swing high
deterministic_criteria.invalidation_thesis: A candle body close beyond the SL level completely invalidates the smart money order flow thesis

rules: Stop loss is anchored to structural invalidation, not emotional pain thresholds.
If price trades beyond the sweep extreme, the institutional premise is null and void.

topics.name: Partial Take Profit & Trade Management

deterministic_criteria.tp2_runner: Next opposing major liquidity pool (Run 30-40% risk-free)
deterministic_criteria.breakeven_rule: Move SL to Entry (Break-Even) once TP1 is hit

rules: Bank substantial profits at 1:2.0 R:R (TP1) to secure a guaranteed winning day.
Trail a runner position toward external range liquidity pools with stop moved to Break-Even.
